choices: Runs once after all tests in the class
Runs after each individual test method — used for cleanup
Skips the next test if the current one passed
Marks a test as expected to fail
explanation: @AfterEach (like @BeforeEach's inverse) runs after every @Test. Use it to tear down shared state: close files, clear caches, reset mocks. @AfterAll runs once after all tests (must be static in standard config).
